how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-unknown-08-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:96395:title: An Ancient Grudge
rows.quest:96395:obj:0: Put the spirit of Faldrim Anvilmar to rest and then return to the Ghostly Attendant in the Hall of Thanes.
rows.quest:96395:details:0: The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.
rows.quest:96395:details:1: Please... help him... help him... rest...
rows.quest:96395:details:2: Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
rows.quest:96896:title: A Righteous Cause
rows.quest:96896:obj:0: Observe the conversation between Danitha Morr and ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:96896:details:0: Danitha and I fought against the scourge in the defense of the ⟦E5⟧ when ⟦E6⟧ attacked. We lost many good friends that day, including the hero after which this keep was named--⟦E7⟧ Bandarion.
rows.quest:96896:details:1: He might just have been the first ⟦E8⟧ to rediscover how to wield the light as a paladin. I am encouraged to see his legacy and potential live on here with Danitha and her cohort.
rows.quest:96896:details:2: If only the rest of the forsaken felt the same way...

rows.quest:98545:title: Leonid's Letter
rows.quest:98545:obj:0: Deliver the ⟦E10⟧ to Glix Xizzix in the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:98545:details:0: Since you are here, I'd like you to deliver this letter to an old friend of mine in the ⟦E5⟧. I'd deliver myself but I have a somewhat colorful history with the Dark Lady, and it would be better if a neutral third party made the delivery.
rows.quest:98545:details:1: You are looking for a goblin named Glix Xizzix in the Trade Quarter area of the ⟦E5⟧. I'm sure he'd be happy to compensate you for your time.
rows.quest:98545:details:2: <Leonid lets out a low chuckle as he hands you the letter.>
rows.quest:98545:progress:0: What's that? You say that Leonid sent you? Oh boy, haven't seen that crusty old soldier since ⟦E6⟧ was raining hell down on our heads.
rows.quest:98545:completion:1: Wait... he said I'd tip you? I didn't agree to that!
rows.quest:98545:completion:2: Fine. Take your pick of this junk in the lost and found. You'd be surprised how many of these ⟦E8⟧ leave their stuff laying around after getting haircuts. There's a joke here about them being brainless, but I suspect in a lot of cases it might actually be true.
rows.quest:99152:title: As Above, So Below
rows.quest:99152:obj:0: Collect 6 Faintly Glowing Bones for Hilda the Breaker.
rows.quest:99152:details:0: While the Tarnished in Shadowvale to the southwest are definitely a problem, we cannot allow the cellars below the town to fester into a full-blown Scourge uprising on Bandarion Keep.
rows.quest:99152:details:1: I need to get these trainees up to snuff in case that happens. You, however, are going to receive what I like to call a crash course.
rows.quest:99152:details:2: ⟦E13⟧ beneath Shadowvale and retrieve some of their wretched bones so we can study them further. I need ones that still retain some of the initial reanimation magic--that's glowing ones.
rows.quest:99152:progress:0: You'd best not be returning empty-handed. I either need the bones I asked for, or your body on a stretcher to confirm you at least gave it your all trying to get them.
rows.quest:99152:completion:0: Well done, recruit. We might just make something out of you yet.
rows.quest:99152:completion:1: With these bones we may be able to better understand how such a threat was able to go unnoticed for so long.
rows.quest:99153:title: The One That Got Away
rows.quest:99153:obj:0: Find the Hidden Crystal Fragment beneath Shadowvale for Ephram Barbaro.
rows.quest:99153:details:0: Oi, you! Word travels quickly among our ranks. I heard about the work you did with the cultists around the remnants of the battle with ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:99153:details:1: Problem is, one of them cultists got away with a piece of the focusing crystal. Seems to still have some juice in it. Best guess we have is it's somewhere beneath Shadowvale. It's either raising 'em or making 'em stronger, and you don't want either one.
rows.quest:99153:details:2: Find that crystal before this gets out of hand.
rows.quest:99153:progress:0: Did you find the damned thing?

rows.quest:94427:title: A Lesson in Divinity
rows.quest:94427:obj:0: Speak to Tanis Alderwood in the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:94427:details:0: A key tenent of being a paladin is the pursuit of divinity. This is not the pursuit of godhood, but merely the pursuit of good itself, for good's sake. We've all arrived at this place due to tragedy of one form or another, and it would be easy to lose that grace that defined us as paladins in life.
rows.quest:94427:details:1: Go to the ⟦E5⟧ and seek out Tanis Alderwood in the Trade Quarter. They are in need, and they could benefit greatly from some grace.
rows.quest:94434:title: A Lesson in Divinity
rows.quest:94434:obj:0: Bring 10 ⟦E23⟧ to Tanis Alderwood in the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:94434:details:0: Wait, you want to... help? Why would a paladin want to help a beggar like me?
rows.quest:94434:details:1: Well, I suppose that you could be of some assistance.
rows.quest:94434:details:2: Its my wife you see. She, well... she's falling apart. I mean that literally. The apothecaries can stitch her back together right as rain, but they are about the Dark Lady's business and none are available to help. If you could perhaps bring me some fresh cloth then I could at least make her a wrapping to hold her together while we wait for the apothecaries.
rows.quest:94434:progress:0: I hope that this is no imposition upon you, goodly paladin.
rows.quest:94435:title: A Lesson in Divinity
rows.quest:94435:obj:0: Return to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep.
rows.quest:94435:details:0: I don't know why you'd go out of your way to help me, but I appreciate it. If someone sent you my way, tell them I appreciate them too. You'll always have a friend in Tanis Alderwood, paladin.
rows.quest:94436:title: A Lesson in Divinity
rows.quest:94436:obj:0: Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.
rows.quest:94436:obj:1: Should you misplace your :⟦E21⟧, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
rows.quest:94436:details:0: It's time to demonstrate your ability to channel one of the light's greatest gifts.
rows.quest:94436:details:1: The item I just gave you is called the ⟦E21⟧. Take care, as it may cause you some discomfort to handle a talisman of the light such as this. The light may be anathema to the force that created us, but it is still our guide and ally. The pain reminds us of this.
rows.quest:94436:details:2: Go see Deathguard Billmuth downstairs. He just arrived and he has petitioned us for aid. Show him and the ⟦E8⟧ what a true paladin can do.
rows.quest:94438:title: A Lesson in Divinity
rows.quest:94438:obj:0: Take the ⟦E21⟧ and use it to ⟦E25⟧ Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale.
rows.quest:94438:obj:1: Should you misplace your ⟦E21⟧, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
rows.quest:94438:obj:2: *Take the ⟦E21⟧ and use it to ⟦E25⟧ Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale.
rows.quest:94438:details:0: Falgan and I were sent on a mission to scout out scarlet activity in Venomweb Vale. We managed to sneak close enough to one of their camps to hear about new orders involving an attack on ⟦E26⟧. Before we could decide what to do next, I stepped on a twig and the noise alerted them to us.
rows.quest:94438:details:1: Falgan yelled at me to run, so I ran. By the time I realized he wasn't with me, I was halfway to ⟦E26⟧. That brave idiot probably stayed behind to hold them off for me.
rows.quest:94438:details:2: Please, find my friend and help him if you can.
rows.quest:94440:title: A Lesson in Divinity
rows.quest:94440:obj:0: Retrieve the ⟦E27⟧ from the ⟦E28⟧ Crusaders at Venomweb Vale, and return to Deathguard Billmuth at Tyr's Watch.
rows.quest:94440:details:0: These ⟦E28⟧ Crusaders often carry satchels with their deployment orders. We know an attack is coming, but if we can recover their orders, we can warn the rest of the Deathguard and prepare an ambush.
rows.quest:94440:details:1: You are clearly an impressive paladin. Kill these scarlet animals and retrieve a copy of their orders and bring them back to Deathguard Billmuth. He'll take it from there.
rows.quest:94441:title: A Lesson in Divinity
rows.quest:94441:obj:0: Speak with Danitha Morr in the keep at Tyr's Watch.
rows.quest:94441:details:0: Please give my thanks to Danitha Morr and tell her that the rest of the Deathguard will hear about the service that the paladins of Tyr's Watch performed for us.
rows.quest:94441:details:1: You have a lot of promise as a paladin, and I am proud to have those like you among the ranks of the ⟦E8⟧. Dark Lady watch over you, .
